title: is-kit Reached 100 Stars ⭐🎉 Here’s What Changed Since 50
why_read: A promotional milestone update for a TypeScript utility library, light on technical substance beyond incremental feature additions.
analysis: This post celebrates a TypeScript library, is-kit, reaching 100 GitHub stars and recaps API changes and a bug found in a dependency (Effect) since the last milestone post. It includes some genuine technical detail about a type-inference edge case, which may interest TypeScript library authors, but overall it reads as a project update/promotional piece rather than substantive technical content. Useful mainly to those already using or curious about this specific small library.
